sections.title: Delivery fee
sections.body: We calculate delivery fees based on the venue you order from and your location. Delivery fees may also be personalized based on your previous activity on our platform using automated decision-making. This venue is 6,300 km away, so your delivery fee is 5.49 €.

sections.title: Small order fee
sections.body: We only add a small order surcharge if your order subtotal is less than the 18.00 € minimum.

sections.title: Service fee
sections.body: The service fee helps us ensure the quality of the Wolt platform, enabling us to enhance our service with new features, provide high-quality customer support, and cover essential costs like technology development. The service fee is 10% of item subtotal, minimum 1.00 € and maximum 3.99 €.

sections.title: Bag
sections.body: Some merchants charge separately for bags or packaging used for your order. This amount is set by the merchant.

toasts.text: Orders below 18.00 € include a small order fee
